senses.gloss: ch. (in Targ. Y.; in O. usu. עֲרַע q. v.) same; to join, meet, find; to attack, visit.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 19:19">Targ. Y. Gen. XIX, 19</cite> <he>תִירְעִינַנִי</he> may befall me <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:10">Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 10</cite> (h. text <he>מצא</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 5:3">Targ. Y. Ex. V, 3</cite> (h. <cite ref="Q00086"><he>פגע</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 4:2">Ib. IV, 2</cite> (h. <cite ref="Q00100"><he>פגש</he></cite>; ed. Vien. <he>ועַרַע</he> read <he>וַאֲרַע</he>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 5:7">Targ. Y. Lev. V, 7</cite> <he>לא תֶאֱרַע ידיה</he> he will not be able, cannot afford (h. text <he>תגיע וכ׳</he>, cmp. <he>תמצא ידו</he>); a. fr. [<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 15:9">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XV, 9</cite> <he>ואַרְעֵי יתהון</he> (I <he>ונָרַע</he>, <he>וגדע</he>) read <he>ואֶירַע</he> and I shall meet them.]

senses.gloss: or Pa. אַרַע to be met; to meet.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 23:15">Targ. Y. I Num. XXIII, 15</cite> <cite ref="P01411"><he>אֶתְעָרַע</he></cite> (h. text <he>אֶקָּרֶה</he>).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 18a">M. Kat. 18ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>איתרע ביה מילתא</he> an accident befell him (death in the family).—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 37:2">Lev. R. s. 37</cite> <he>אַרְעַת שעתא</he> it so happened.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:1">Koh. R. to XI, 1</cite> <he>ארעת ענת׳ וכ׳</he> it happened to be the season when the Israelites travelled to Jerusalem. Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ <he>אירעון</he>, v. <cite ref="A03215">preced.</cite>
Targ. Esth. VIII, 8 תִתְּרַן = תתארען; Targ. Y. Gen. XLIV, 34 תברז (corr. acc.). [אתרע to be shaken, weakened, v. רעע.]
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 2:3">Targ. Ruth II, 3</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 85:11">Targ. Ps. LXXXV, 11</cite> <he>אוֹרְעוּן</he> (some ed. <he>אָרְעִין</he> Pe.) meet each other.
